The Growing Demand for EV Charger Installation in Los Angeles

Los Angeles is at the forefront of the electric vehicle revolution, and the infrastructure to support it is rapidly expanding. According to the U.S. Department of Energy's Alternative Fuels Data Center, the number of public EV charging ports in the United States has grown more than six-fold over the last decade, from about 30,000 in 2016 to nearly 196,000 in January 2025. This explosive growth reflects the increasing adoption of electric vehicles across California, particularly in metropolitan areas like Los Angeles.

For property owners in Los Angeles, installing a home or commercial EV charger is no longer just a luxury, it's becoming a necessity. California's building codes now require EV charging infrastructure for new construction, and existing properties are rapidly upgrading to meet demand. As detailed in our comprehensive guide on EV charging infrastructure for Los Angeles property owners in 2025, the state has implemented progressive requirements that mandate EV-ready parking spaces in new multifamily housing and commercial developments.

Shaffer Construction specializes in both residential and commercial EV charger installations throughout Los Angeles. Our team handles every aspect of the installation process, from conducting electrical load studies to determine if your existing panel can support the additional demand, to pulling necessary permits from the Los Angeles Department of Building and Safety, to the final installation and testing. We work with all major charger brands and can recommend the best solution for your specific needs, whether that's a basic Level 2 charger for home use or a sophisticated networked charging system for a commercial property.

The technical requirements for EV charger installation are more complex than many property owners realize. Most Level 2 chargers require a dedicated 240-volt circuit with 40 to 50 amps of capacity, which often necessitates panel upgrades or electrical service increases. Shaffer Construction's electricians are fully licensed and experienced in navigating these requirements, ensuring your installation meets all code requirements while optimizing for performance and future scalability.

Electrical Panel Upgrades and Modern Safety Requirements

One of the most critical services Shaffer Construction provides to Los Angeles property owners is electrical panel upgrades. Many homes and commercial buildings in Los Angeles were built decades ago with electrical systems designed for much lower power demands. As we add more appliances, smart home technology, air conditioning systems, and especially EV chargers, these older panels often become inadequate and even dangerous.

The 2023 National Electrical Code (NEC), which has been adopted by California and Los Angeles, introduces significant new safety requirements that often trigger the need for panel upgrades. According to leading electrical equipment manufacturer Eaton, the NEC 2023 expands both Arc-Fault Circuit Interrupter (AFCI) and Ground-Fault Circuit Interrupter (GFCI) protection requirements to cover more areas of residential and commercial properties than ever before.

AFCI protection, which helps prevent electrical fires caused by arcing faults, is now required for virtually all 15 and 20-ampere branch circuits in dwelling units, including kitchens, laundry areas, and dining rooms. GFCI protection, which prevents electrical shock hazards, has been expanded to include kitchen appliances, laundry areas, and even certain large appliances like ranges and dryers. As explained in this detailed article on new safety standards for AFCI and GFCI requirements in 2025 homes, these changes represent a significant leap forward in electrical safety but also mean that many older panels need to be upgraded to accommodate modern circuit breakers with these safety features.

Shaffer Construction's approach to panel upgrades goes beyond simply meeting minimum code requirements. Our electricians conduct thorough electrical load studies, as detailed in our electrical load studies services, to calculate your current and anticipated future electrical needs. This ensures that when we upgrade your panel, it has sufficient capacity not just for today's demands, but for future additions like EV chargers, solar panel systems, or additional circuits for home expansions.

During a panel upgrade, Shaffer Construction replaces your outdated electrical panel with a modern unit that typically offers 200-amp service, though we can design systems up to 400 amps or more for larger properties. We ensure all circuits are properly labeled, install the required AFCI and GFCI breakers, verify proper grounding, and coordinate with Los Angeles Department of Water and Power (LADWP) for any necessary service upgrades. The entire process is performed to code, with all required permits and inspections completed.

Electrical Safety Inspections and Code Compliance

Electrical safety should never be taken for granted, especially in a city with as much building stock as Los Angeles, where many properties were constructed before modern safety standards existed. Shaffer Construction provides comprehensive electrical safety inspections that identify potential hazards before they become serious problems.

Our electrical safety inspections are thorough and systematic. We examine your entire electrical system, including the service entrance, main panel, subpanels, branch circuits, outlets, switches, and permanently connected appliances. We look for common hazards such as overloaded circuits, outdated wiring, improper grounding, missing GFCI or AFCI protection, damaged insulation, and signs of overheating or arcing. We also verify that all electrical work has been performed to code and that any previous modifications or additions were properly permitted.

For property owners buying or selling real estate in Los Angeles, an electrical safety inspection from Shaffer Construction provides valuable peace of mind. Buyers want assurance that the electrical system is safe and adequate for their needs, while sellers can address any issues proactively rather than facing surprises during escrow. Our detailed inspection reports document the condition of the electrical system and provide clear recommendations for any needed repairs or upgrades.

Code compliance is particularly important in Los Angeles, where the Department of Building and Safety actively enforces electrical codes. Any electrical work performed without proper permits can create liability issues and complications when selling a property. Shaffer Construction handles all permit applications and coordinates with city inspectors to ensure that every project is completed in full compliance with local, state, and national electrical codes.

Our expertise in residential EV charger installation demonstrates our commitment to code compliance. EV charger installations require specific permits from LADBS, and the work must be performed by licensed electricians following strict requirements outlined in Article 625 of the California Electrical Code. We ensure that every charger installation meets these requirements, from proper circuit sizing and overcurrent protection to appropriate location and mounting.

Lighting Solutions and Energy Efficiency Upgrades

Lighting represents a significant portion of electricity consumption in both residential and commercial properties, making it an ideal target for energy efficiency improvements. Shaffer Construction specializes in modern lighting solutions that enhance aesthetics, improve functionality, and dramatically reduce energy costs.

LED technology has revolutionized the lighting industry, offering light quality comparable to or better than traditional incandescent and fluorescent lighting while using a fraction of the electricity. LED lights also last far longer, reducing maintenance costs and the hassle of frequent bulb replacements. Shaffer Construction designs and installs LED lighting systems for every application, from ambient lighting in residential living spaces to sophisticated commercial lighting systems with dimming, color temperature control, and smart automation.

For commercial properties, the energy savings from LED retrofits can be substantial. We've helped Los Angeles businesses reduce their lighting electricity consumption by 60 to 80 percent through strategic LED upgrades. These projects typically pay for themselves within two to four years through reduced electricity bills, and LADWP offers rebates that can offset a significant portion of the initial investment.

Beyond simple LED bulb replacements, Shaffer Construction designs comprehensive lighting systems that optimize both energy efficiency and user experience. We install occupancy sensors that automatically turn lights off in unoccupied spaces, daylight harvesting systems that dim artificial lighting when natural light is sufficient, and programmable lighting controls that adjust throughout the day. For residential clients, we create layered lighting designs that combine ambient, task, and accent lighting to create beautiful, functional spaces.

Outdoor lighting is another specialty area for Shaffer Construction. We install landscape lighting that enhances curb appeal and security, parking lot lighting for commercial properties, and architectural lighting that highlights building features. All outdoor lighting systems are designed to meet current energy codes while providing excellent visibility and safety.
